newsitem.title: USA: Intelligroup Inc amends IPO filing.
newsitem.headline: Intelligroup Inc amends IPO filing.

text.p: Intelligroup Inc said on Friday that it revised its initial public offering plans because of market conditions.
The company is now offering 2,475,000 shares of common stock at an estimated price range of $8 to $10 a share, the company said.

In the company's June filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, it was offering 2.25 million shares at $9 to $11 each, Intelligroup chief financial officer Robert Olanoff said in a telephone interview.
Intelligroup said it was selling 2.05 million shares to the public and 425,000 are being sold by shareholders.
